manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: The fields, the rules AND the painted label are delivered; the look, the position and the colour match are yours to confirm.

items.step: Check the fields the overlay will show for a point and a line (type, size, validity, length).
items.machine_proven: I1/I2: kind, bounding size and validity come from the model; a line reports its length.
items.human_must_verify: The wording and units match what you expect the label to read.

items.step: Check the rule for geometry without a measurement (mesh, native B-rep without a payload).
items.machine_proven: I3/I4/J1: the size is Unavailable with a reason and never 0,0,0.
items.human_must_verify: You agree the overlay should say 'unavailable' rather than showing a zero.

items.step: Check the colour: the label is drawn in the object's layer colour.
items.machine_proven: I5: the info carries the colour when the object/layer has one.
items.human_must_verify: The colour you expect is the colour you would see on the label.

items.step: Select ONE object and look at the label beside it.
items.machine_proven: the label text is unit-tested and the receipt carries the same line; the label is painted at the projected object centre in the layer colour.
items.human_must_verify: The label sits beside the object without covering it, reads type · size · validity, and disappears when nothing (or more than one object) is selected.
